references.text: John 5:24 is a direct parallel where Jesus declares that whoever hears his word and believes has eternal life and will not come into judgment but has passed from death to life, which is the core of the promise in John 8:51.
John 11:25-26 confirms the promise of not seeing death by declaring that whoever lives and believes in Jesus will live forever even if they die, and that no one who lives and believes will ever die.
